clauses.title: Pricing & Seat Cap
clauses.literal_text: Flat $48,000 up to 50 seats; extra seats need signed written amendment; no automatic or verbal discounting.

clauses.title: Renewal
clauses.literal_text: Auto-renews 12 months unless written notice 60 days before term ends; no mid-term termination.

clauses.title: Support SLA
clauses.literal_text: P1 within 4 business hours Mon-Fri 9-6 ET; 24/7 requires Premium Support Addendum.
